svg.title: Comic 3.1 — Who checks the agents?
svg.desc: Dee announces that agents write all the code; Pat asks who checks them. Other agents, says Dee; and who checks those? Better agents! Final panel: a tall stack of little robots, each inspecting the one below, held up at the bottom by Pat.
svg.text: Every jump adds a layer. Somebody still has to hold up the bottom.
